title: Create a structured note
instruction: Open the notes application, create a note titled Project Checklist, add three checklist items, and leave the note open.
success_criteria: A note titled Project Checklist exists
The note contains exactly three checklist items
The final state leaves the note visible

title: Find and record a webpage value
instruction: Open the sample product page, find the listed price, record it in the notes application, and return to the product page.
success_criteria: The sample product page is opened
The displayed price is identified correctly
The value is recorded in the notes application
The final state returns to the product page

title: Organize files into a folder
instruction: Create a folder named Review Pack and move the two supplied text files into it.
success_criteria: A folder named Review Pack exists
Both supplied text files are inside Review Pack
